subject: GCP Marketplace seller checkpoint & procurement lane setup
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>, procure@acmecloud.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: GCP Marketplace seller checkpoint & procurement lane setup

Hi Priyanka / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for committing to a GCP Marketplace listing pilot. Before we kick off technical work with GCP partner enablement, we need to lock the procurement lane to avoid last-minute SLA or invoice delays. Attached is a first-pass "procure-lane-matrix.xlsx" that maps the intake -> approval -> billing handoff. Key asks for you:

- Confirm the PO contact and expected PO turnaround (we've listed procure@acmecloud.com as the recipient).
- Any internal thresholds that require legal review (e.g., revenue share > $X, data residency clauses).
- The billing cadence you prefer (monthly invoicing vs. net-30 via reseller).

Tentative timeline: if we get procurement confirmation by 2026-03-08, Redwood can complete the listing activation window by 2026-03-22 and enable co-sell routing.

Attachments: procure-lane-matrix.xlsx, roles-responsibilities-map.pdf

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priyanka Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace seller checkpoint & procurement lane setup

Thanks David — adding a couple of clarifying notes inline and a request for a quick procurement contact sync.

Quick points:
- For co-sell enablement we need the billing contact + a customer-signed commercial contact who can approve the Marketplace T&Cs. If that person is different from procure@acmecloud.com, please point us to them.
- I added a column in the matrix for "who signs GCP listing terms" (legal vs procurement). Priyanka, can you confirm?
- We should also document whether Acme requires an invoice to include a PO number on every invoice — that will affect our ERP mapping.

Can we do a 30-min call on 2026-03-05 between 10:00-11:00 PT to align? I'll send a calendar invite once we have confirmation.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Priyanka Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace seller checkpoint & procurement lane setup

Hi David / Vanessa — thanks for the matrix, looks helpful. Quick answers from procurement: 

- PO contact: procure@acmecloud.com (that mailbox is monitored by Samir Patel and legal escalation goes to legal@acmecloud.com).
- PO turnaround: standard internal SLA is 7 business days once we have a completed contract and pricing. If we need faster turnaround we can request expedited review.
- Invoice requirements: must include PO# in the invoice header; we prefer monthly consolidated invoices.
- Listing terms: Generally signed by Legal (legal@acmecloud.com). For standard Marketplace listings we've been able to use an executed MSA and route the listing terms to procurement for signature.

We can do 2026-03-05 at 10:30 PT. I'll have Samir on the call.

Thanks,
Priyanka Rao
VP, Commercial Ops
Acme Cloud
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyanka Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace seller checkpoint & procurement lane setup

Great sync this morning — noted the procurement SLA and PO requirements. I've sketched a handoff flow below (owners + deliverables) so we can turn the matrix into an actionable checklist: 

- Redwood Sales Ops (David Kim): push final commercial terms; confirm if Acme prefers revenue share or fixed listing fee. Deliverable: signed order (target 2026-03-10).
- Acme Procurement (Samir Patel / procure@acmecloud.com): confirm PO process and provide sample PO template. Deliverable: PO or confirmation of invoicing cadence (target 2026-03-12).
- Redwood GTM (Vanessa Ortiz): prepare co-sell enablement docs and routing tags for GCP partner team. Deliverable: co-sell routing spec (target 2026-03-15).
- Legal (Marissa Cole): review marketplace T&Cs mapping to existing MSA; flag any non-standard clauses. Deliverable: legal signoff memo (target 2026-03-12).

I'll attach a one-page handoff flow to the Drive folder. Also linking the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2026-031 (please add the PO number to the deal once received so finance can reconcile).

-Karthik
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>, procure@acmecloud.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace seller checkpoint & procurement lane setup

Thanks everyone — recap and next steps: 

1) Acme to send sample PO template to procure@acmecloud.com and confirm whether expedited review is needed. Samir / procurement target: 2026-03-12.
2) Marissa will provide legal mapping and signoff memo by 2026-03-12.
3) David to circulate final commercial term sheet (attached) and request signature — target 2026-03-10 (done; see attached calendar-invite-rcpt.ics for the signature meeting).
4) Vanessa to hand off routing spec to GCP partner enablement by 2026-03-15.

Attachments: calendar-invite-rcpt.ics

If no blockers by 2026-03-12 we proceed with listing activation window week of 2026-03-22. If Acme needs a faster path to co-sell before that, we can enable limited routing with manual approvals.

--
David Kim
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
